description: THE OPENING POSITION IS ONE LAYER, AND UNDER FIFO IT IS THE FIRST ONE OUT. The books open with 4.0000 units at 25.0000 = 100.0000 (a stock_opening row, not a movement). PUR-1 then receives 10.0000 @ 50.0000 = 500.0000. SAL-1 issues 6.0000: FIFO empties the OPENING layer first (all 4.0000 units, 100.0000) and takes the remaining 2.0000 out of PUR-1 at 50.0000 (100.0000) -> consumed 200.0000. Closing 8.0000 units, all of them PUR-1's, at 400.0000, rate 50.0000. Conservation: 100.0000 + 500.0000 - 200.0000 = 400.0000. WHY THIS FIXTURE EXISTS SEPARATELY FROM 08: a replay seeds its state from the opening as a bare quantity-and-value pair with NO layer list, so a lot-queue valuer that only ever appended layers on a receipt would have found an empty queue, consumed nothing at all for the first 4.0000 units and reported this position at 500.0000 - value invented out of an opening it could not see. Weighted average on the same three facts consumes 257.1429 and closes at 342.8571, so this is also a third distinct answer from the same books.
